Enrollment

Every Journey Begins with Understanding How You Build.

At the empowerHER Legacy Institute for Entrepreneurship Excellence, we believe entrepreneurs deserve a learning experience informed by how they naturally build.

For that reason, enrollment in Project Management for Real Life: Entrepreneurial Edition™ begins with the Entrepreneurship Readiness Assessment™ (ERA).

The ERA identifies your Builder Profile™ and serves as the foundation for your learning experience inside the PMFRL Methodology™.

Once you’ve completed the assessment, you’ll receive your Builder Profile™ and be guided to the next step in the enrollment process.

Take the Entrepreneurship Readiness Assessment
